title: Recruiting Coordinator — Daily Scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad — quick log + to-dos (people ops recruiting coordinator)
Date: 2026-03-04 (Wed)
Timezone: PST (UTC-8)

Morning quick list (priorities)
- [ ] Confirm interview panel for Senior Infra Engineer (Eliot Park) — 10:30am PT
- [ ] Follow up w/ candidates from last week (3 outstanding)
- [ ] Send calendar invites for take-home test + instructions (Data Eng candidate: Priya)
- [ ] Reconcile interview feedback for PM loop (notes missing for 2 interviewers)
- [ ] Block 1.5h for candidate packet prep (resumes, scorecard, rubric)

Inbox triage (notes)
- Eliot Park — panel confirmation email from hiring manager (Maya) at 08:45; need to CC interviewers and include Zoom link + prep doc. Action: send invite + attach "Interview prep for panel" confluence link. (Avery to confirm availability)
- Priya Sharma — sent take-home instructions draft (attached below). Candidate asked for extra 48h (family emergency) — ok to extend? Hiring manager approved +1 day. Update test due date to 3/6. Action: send confirmation + new deadline.
- Jamal Ortiz — recruiter left voicemail; candidate requested alternate times after 2pm PT only. Panel availability currently 3/5 2:30pm, 3/5 4pm, 3/8 3pm. Action: propose 3/5 4pm and 3/8 3pm; wait for reply.

Interview schedule (today)
- 10:30am PT — Senior Infra Engineer (Eliot Park) — Panel: Maya (hiring mgr), K. Li (peer), R. Chen (SRE) — Zoom: zoom.us/j/xxxxx — PREP: send checklist: 5 min intro, 40 min system design, 10 min Qs, close. (Ensure K. Li has laptop for whiteboard)
- 1:00pm PT — Recruiter screen follow-up with pipeline candidates (internal sync) — 30m — join: calendar
- 3:00pm PT — Onsite coordination call w/ ops (block 30m) — confirm lunch options for candidates 3/12 (dietary restrictions noted)

Follow-ups & templates to send
- Candidate follow-up template (short):
  Hi {{name}},
  Thanks again for taking the time to speak with us. Quick next steps: hiring team is reviewing feedback; we expect to get back to you by EOD Friday. If you have questions, reply here.
  —Casey

- Scheduling propose template (3 options):
  Hi {{name}},
  Thanks for your flexibility. Would any of these work for you?
  • Thu 3/5 4:00pm PT
  • Fri 3/6 3:00pm PT
  • Mon 3/9 10:00am PT
  Please let me know all times that work and any timezone constraints.

Notes on feedback collection
- Two interviewers haven't submitted scorecards for PM final loop (J. Park, L. Gomez). Deadline to submit: EOD today. Ping via Slack + email.
- Missing feedback on Data Eng take-home (Priya) expected after extension; recruiter will flag if not received by 3/7.

Logistics / Admin reminders
- Zoom account limits: double-check host account for 10:30 panel (Maya is host, but K. Li might also need co-host). If not, assign co-host before meeting.
- Building access for onsite: guest badges need to be ordered by Friday 3/6. Ops contact: Riley Chen.
- Background check: new offer for L3 Sales Ops (candidate: Marco Silva) — send BGC packet once offer accepted.

Personal TODOs (short)
- [ ] Book interview rooms for onsite week of 3/15 (rooms A/B reserved?)
- [ ] Update interviewers rotation spreadsheet (sheet REC-rotation) — add new interviewers: N. Patel, S. Gomez
- [ ] Create shared drive folder for PM final loop (link in confluence)
- [ ] Prep candidate packet for Eliot — attach resume, JD, past PRs, rubric

Open questions / things to confirm
- Do we allow 24h take-home extension as standard? Current guideline says +48h only for documented reasons. Check with People Ops policy (linked).
- Hiring manager asked for "lighter" rubric for staff+ roles — need to align with growth/benchmarks team. Add to agenda for weekly ops sync.

Quick snippets / notes to self
- Slack DM Maya after stand to confirm co-hosting.
- Add "candidate experience survey" link to post-interview email (short 3 Qs). Draft saved in confluence.
- Move recurring block "candidate packet prep" to Tues/Thurs 9:30-11am starting next week.

End-of-day wrap (placeholder)
- capture any changes here (time stamped) + mark completed tasks.

---
Recent changes log (auto-notes I write here)
- 08:52 — Extended Priya take-home by 1 day (approved by Maya). Sent confirm email.
- 09:15 — Tentatively confirmed Eliot panel; awaiting K. Li final ok.
- 09:42 — Sent reminder to J. Park + L. Gomez for scorecards.

Attachments / links I keep in the candidate packet (paste list here for fast copy)
- resume: drive link (paste)
- JD: confluence link
- rubric: internal: REC-rubric v4
- take-home instructions: text below (finalize before sending)

Take-home instructions (draft)
Hi {{name}},
Thanks for agreeing to the take-home exercise. Please find the prompt and rubric attached. Recommended time: 3–5 hours. Submit as a single PDF to this email by {{due-date}}. If you need more time, let us know at least 24 hours before the deadline and include a reason.

Thanks,
Casey

(End scratchpad)
